x-jsf-presentation.description:
I acknowledge that notice periods are as follows:
  • 2 weeks for employees who have worked for the employer for up to 6 months
  • 1 month for employees who have worked for the employer between 6 months and 2 years
  • 2 months for employees who have worked for the employer for over 2 years, up to 5 years
  • 3 months for employees who have worked for the employer for over 5 years
These notice terms cannot be altered by written agreement. However, it is possible to replace the notice period with the salary the employee would have earned until the end of the notice period.
